description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) for employee anniversary search filter parameters within the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and encapsulates properties such as the current year, next anniversary date, and minimum/maximum date differences, along with their getters and setters.

classes.name: EmployeeAnniversarySearchFilterParams
classes.description: DTO class encapsulating filter parameters for employee anniversary searches, including year, date, and date difference bounds.

properties.name: thisYear
properties.description: The reference year for the filter.

properties.name: nextDate
properties.description: The next anniversary date to filter.

properties.name: dateDiffMin
properties.description: Minimum difference in days between current date and anniversary.

properties.name: dateDiffMax
properties.description: Maximum difference in days between current date and anniversary.

methods.name: getThisYear
methods.description: Returns the current year string used in the filter.

methods.name: setThisYear
methods.description: Sets the current year string used in the filter.

methods.name: getNextDate
methods.description: Returns the next anniversary date for filtering.

methods.name: setNextDate
methods.description: Sets the next anniversary date for filtering.

methods.name: getDateDiffMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum days difference for the filter.

methods.name: setDateDiffMin
methods.description: Sets the minimum days difference for the filter.

methods.name: getDateDiffMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum days difference for the filter.

methods.name: setDateDiffMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum days difference for the filter.
